info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Etas-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride ETA Retrieval API provides real-time estimated time of arrival (ETA) information for rideshare services. This API enables users to efficiently track the expected arrival of rides by accessing key data associated with specific rides. Typical consumers include rideshare applications, logistics platforms, and user-facing mobile applications that require timely updates on ride availability. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experience with accurate ETAs, facilitating better planning and decision-making for passengers.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated time of arrival for a ride.
get.description: This endpoint provides the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for a specified ride. Users can input their ride details to receive accurate ETA information based on current traffic conditions and ride routes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for rides. Ensure that all required parameters are included in the request body as specified by the schema.

200.description: The estimated time of arrival for the ride has been successfully retrieved.

ListRideshareRidesEtasRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation related to ride ETA inquiries. This should contain the necessary parameters formatted as a string.

ListRideshareRidesEtasResponse_200.title: Ride ETA Response
